question: Who among the following is one of the seven winners of the Young Champions of the Earth 2020 prize given by UNEP?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vidyut Mohan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vidyut Mohan:**__

 __
 
• He is the co-founder of **'Takachar'** a social enterprise enabling farmers to prevent the open burning of their waste farm residues.
 
• He is among the seven winners of the 'Young Champions of the Earth" prize.
 
• The prize is given by the UN environment agency to global change-makers using innovative ideas and ambitious actions.
 
 
 
• **Young Champions of the Earth 2020:**__
 __
 
• Seven Young Champions of the Earth will be selected from each global region: Africa, Europe, Latin America and the Caribbean, North America, West Asia and the Pacific.
 
• Each winner will receive USD 10,000 in seed funding.
 
• Seven winners are **Fatemah Alzzelzela (Kuwait), Lefteris Arapakis (Greece), Max Hidalgo Quinto (Peru), Niria Alicia Garcia (United States of America), Nzambi Matee (Kenya), Xiaoyuan Ren (China), Vidyut Mohan (India).​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP)**__

 
 
• It was established in** 1972.**
 
• It is formed to guide and coordinate environmental activities within the United Nations system.
 
• UNEP promotes international cooperation on environmental issues, provides guidance to UN organizations.
 
• **HQ**- Nairobi, Kenya.
 
• **Chairman**: Inger Anderson
